description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - Appointed B. D. A. S. Sumedha as the Mayor of the Kurunegala Municipal Council on 02.02.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. Borupage Don Aruna Shantha Sumedha) as the Mayor of the Municipal Council Kurunegala. The appointment is made under the authority of the Local Government Elections (Amendment) Act, and the notice is issued pursuant to the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This content directly concerns an electoral process and the filling of an elected local government office, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7). While a person is named, the primary focus is on the electoral and governance process for a local authority, not on detailing the mayor's portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify as a Hybrid (Type 3) gazette.
